description: Get all comments from the document with IDs, authors, dates, text, and anchored paragraph IDs. Range-anchored DOCX comments also expose optional end_paragraph_id, start_run_index, start_char_offset, end_run_index, and end_char_offset fields describing the covered span. Includes threaded replies (DOCX). Supports DOCX and ODT. Read-only.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

name: get_comments
